name: Smart Snap
description: Snaps dragged objects to nearby object edges and centers in the editor, like a design-tool smart guide.

enabled.name: Enable Smart Snap
enabled.description: Master toggle for edge/center snapping in the editor.

snap-distance.name: Snap Distance
snap-distance.description: How close (in editor units) an edge needs to be before it snaps.

snap-to-centers.name: Snap to Centers
snap-to-centers.description: Also snap to the horizontal/vertical center of nearby objects, not just edges.

show-guides.name: Show Guide Lines
show-guides.description: Draw a line across the screen when a snap is active.

disable-key.name: Disable-While-Held Key
disable-key.description: Hold this key while dragging to temporarily disable snapping.
